rows.note: This is the all-purpose everyday choice for following rules or behaving properly.

example.english: Children should show conformity by behaving properly when eating at a restaurant.
example.traditional: 小朋友喺餐廳食飯都要守規矩。
example.jyutping: siu2 pang4 jau5 hai2 caan1 teng1 sik6 faan6 dou1 jiu3 sau2 kwai1 geoi2

rows.note: Use this when conformity means meeting an explicit rule, requirement, or standard rather than actively obeying it.

example.english: This plug is in conformity with the regulations and can be sold in Hong Kong.
example.traditional: 呢款插頭符合規定，可以喺香港出售。
example.jyutping: ni1 fun2 caap3 tau2 fu4 hap6 kwai1 ding6 ho2 ji5 hai2 hoeng1 gong2 ceot1 sau6

rows.note: Use this mainly for formal or professional contexts involving regulatory or technical compliance.

example.english: The company must submit a report every year to prove the business’s conformity with regulations.
example.traditional: 公司每年都要提交報告，證明業務合規。
example.jyutping: gung1 si1 mui5 nin4 dou1 jiu3 tai4 gaau1 bou3 gou3 zing3 ming4 jip6 mou6 hap6 kwai1
